What happens when you take AutoCAD out of the computer? 🚧

Another great round of hands-on learning, problem-solving, and knowledge sharing!

items.description: If you’re building a list of places to eat in Downtown Spartanburg, Lucy Anne’s should be on it 🍝 We’ve already introduced you to this new addition to downtown, but after looking back at these plates, we’re reminded there’s still plenty on the menu we need to try 🤩 Consider this your sign to make a reservation and see what’s cooking at @lucy.annes for your next dinner downtown. 📍 148 W Main St, Spartanburg, SC 29306 #DowntownSpartanburgSC #ExperienceSpartanburg #SpartanburgSC
